calls:
run sh -c linked() {
  p=${1%/*}
  while [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$p" != "$2" ] && [ "$p" != / ]; do
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
      if [ -n "$3" ] && r=$(realpath "$p" 2>/dev/null); then case $r/ in "$3"/*) p=${p%/*}; continue;; esac; fi
      printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$(readlink "$p")"
      return 0
    fi
    p=${p%/*}
  done
  return 1
}
p=$1; shift
[ -d "$p" ] || { printf '\036END\n'; exit 0; }
b=$(realpath "$p") || exit 1
for r in "$@"; do
  l=$(linked "$r/." "$p" "$b") && printf '%s\t%s\n' "$r" "$l"
done
printf '\036END\n' sh /Users/dev/p /Users/dev/p/.claude/skills (20000 ms)
